description: This file declares the ProtobufIRReader class, which inherites from IRReader and is responsible for reading and converting protobuf-encoded ABI information into internal IR representations. It includes methods for parsing various types, functions, variables, and ABI-specific structures from protobuf data.

classes.name: ProtobufIRReader
classes.description: A class that reads protobuf-encoded ABI information and converts it into internal IR structures, inheriting from IRReader.

methods.name: ReadDumpImpl
methods.description: Implements reading and parsing of the dump file; likely the main entry point for reading data.

methods.description: Parses function information from the protobuf translation unit.

methods.description: Converts protobuf BasicNamedAndTypedDecl into internal TypeIR.
